items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: when I lived in New York I was doing “Funny Girl” with Barbra Streisand in the pit.

ctx.x: He used to live here. I used to — when I lived in New York I was doing “Funny Girl” with Barbra Streisand in the pit. And on my way home I had to pass the club, with the jazz club there and Bill would be playing with Woody. And we didn’t talk a whole bunch but then after I got off Stan Kenton’s band then all of a sudden we were good friends. Then he moved out here and when I left Vic Damone I got Bill to take my place, when I went to LA to get to the studios. And we became good friends. Another Italian trumpet…
Okay. Yeah it took up too much space on the record.
